title: Giants RB Najee Harris excited to play for former division rival, John Harbaugh: 'We align with each other'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants RB Najee Harris excited to play for former division rival, John Harbaugh: 'We align with each other'
sources.description: The former AFC North connection between Najee Harris and Giants head coach John Harbaugh was one of the main reasons the RB chose to sign with New York.
